support_bodies.name: west core-hold and service-furniture tree
support_bodies.rationale: The first contact carries the cold core's west aft hold-down soffit over its insertion lane; the west-strip and rear-wall contacts above it join the same removable body. A pillar in that lane blocks the core ride, and the retained tree grows from the bed through the open box.

support_bodies.name: forward west service-furniture tree
support_bodies.rationale: The ASSE pan sleeve's remaining floor lies beyond the wall-rooted corbel, and the anchor and west-wall service furniture above it must keep the pan withdrawal and tie-channel lanes open. Their contacts share one bed-rooted tree instead of separate material-rooted bodies.

support_bodies.name: middle west service-furniture tree
support_bodies.rationale: The west-wall service contacts in this depth band keep the component and wiring lanes open. Their four interfaces share one bed-rooted tree instead of separate stacks rooted on the wall furniture.

support_bodies.name: east core-hold, rear-wall and Wago-roof tree
support_bodies.rationale: The first contact carries the cold core's east aft hold-down soffit over its insertion lane; the east rear-wall contacts above it join the same removable body. Each of the five Wago wells keeps one complete flat ceiling that grips its lever nut, so the slicer retains exactly one interface island in each pocket on this same bed-rooted tree. The wells' wall and ceiling corbels remain simple and self-supporting.

support_bodies.name: east ceiling-strip tree
support_bodies.rationale: The +X Y-seam tongue and the constrained ceiling-strip reliefs must remain open to the mating piece and the power-column furniture. They form one long tree from the bed rather than short stacks on the seam or wall features.

support_bodies.name: collet-plate stop and pump-bay lintel tree
support_bodies.rationale: The lower contact carries the exact 1 mm flat land that stops the steel collet plate and defines its Z datum; its fore edge is already raked at 45 degrees. The upper contact is the lintel that closes the full-width removable pump-cartridge bay while carrying the display above it. A support-free gable across that deep opening would occupy the rectangular cartridge-withdrawal or display envelope. The two contacts share one long bed-rooted tree, so neither hides a separate short or material-rooted support.

support_bodies.name: X- pump boss-bearing shoulder
support_bodies.rationale: The flat annular shoulder bears axially on the fitted pump boss while the complete octagonal wall locates X, Y and yaw. Chamfering the shoulder would trade away bearing area rather than remove an accidental overhang; its centre bore remains open for direct support removal.
